description:
The Scheme of Conferring ‘Kalaichemmal’ Awards was launched by the Government of Tamil Nadu on 15th September 2019. 

This scheme aims to recognize and honor the contributions of artists in various fields of art and culture. 

The initiative is part of the Tamil Nadu government's efforts to promote and preserve the rich cultural heritage of the state. 

The term ‘Kalaichemmal’ translates to ‘Artistic Excellence’ in English. 

The scheme is designed to encourage artists who have made significant contributions to the fields of music, dance, drama, and other performing arts. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance and recognition to artists who have excelled in their respective fields. 

The awards are intended to motivate artists to continue their work and inspire future generations. 

The scheme also aims to promote cultural activities across Tamil Nadu. 

Under this scheme, a total of 100 artists are selected for the awards each year. 

Each awardee receives a cash prize of ₹1 lakh. 

In addition to the cash prize, awardees also receive a certificate of recognition. 

The awards are conferred during a state-level function organized by the Tamil Nadu Department of Arts and Culture. 

The selection process for the awards is conducted by a committee formed by the government. 

This committee comprises experts from various fields of art and culture. 

The committee evaluates the contributions of artists based on their body of work and impact on society. 

Artists from various disciplines including classical music, folk music, classical dance, and traditional crafts are eligible for the awards. 

The eligibility criteria for the Kalaichemmal Awards include being a resident of Tamil Nadu. 

Artists must have a proven track record of at least 10 years in their respective fields. 

The scheme is open to artists of all age groups. 

There are no specific educational qualifications required to apply for the awards. 

However, the applicant must demonstrate significant contributions to the arts. 

The application process for the Kalaichemmal Awards is straightforward. 

Interested artists must submit an application form to the Tamil Nadu Department of Arts and Culture. 

The application form can be obtained from the official website of the department. 

Along with the application form, artists must submit a portfolio of their work. 

The portfolio should include evidence of their contributions to the arts. 

This may include recordings of performances, photographs, and testimonials from recognized figures in the arts community. 

The deadline for submitting applications is typically set for 31st July each year. 

After the deadline, the selection committee reviews all applications. 

The results are usually announced by 15th August each year. 

The awards ceremony is then held on 15th September to coincide with the launch date of the scheme. 

The implementing authority for the Kalaichemmal Awards is the Tamil Nadu Department of Arts and Culture. 

The department is responsible for promoting and preserving the cultural heritage of Tamil Nadu. 

For any inquiries regarding the awards, individuals can contact the department at its official office. 

The contact details for the Tamil Nadu Department of Arts and Culture are available on their official website. 

The scheme has been well-received by the artistic community in Tamil Nadu. 

It has encouraged many artists to continue their work and strive for excellence in their fields. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹1 crore annually for the implementation of the Kalaichemmal Awards. 

This budget covers the cash prizes and administrative costs associated with the awards. 

The scheme has also led to increased visibility for artists in Tamil Nadu. 

Awardees often gain recognition at both state and national levels. 

This recognition can lead to further opportunities for performances and collaborations. 

The Kalaichemmal Awards serve as a platform for artists to showcase their talents. 

The awards have also fostered a sense of community among artists in Tamil Nadu. 

Many awardees have expressed gratitude for the recognition and support provided by the government. 

The scheme has contributed to the overall cultural development of the state. 

It has also played a role in preserving traditional art forms that may be at risk of fading away. 

The government encourages artists to apply for the awards and take advantage of this opportunity. 

The Kalaichemmal Awards are a testament to the Tamil Nadu government's commitment to the arts. 

By recognizing and rewarding artistic talent, the scheme helps to ensure the continued vibrancy of Tamil Nadu's cultural landscape. 

The awards not only honor individual artists but also celebrate the rich tapestry of Tamil Nadu's artistic heritage. 

Overall, the Scheme of Conferring ‘Kalaichemmal’ Awards is a significant initiative. 

It highlights the importance of arts and culture in society. 

The scheme aims to inspire creativity and innovation among artists. 

It also seeks to engage the public in appreciating and participating in cultural activities. 

Through this scheme, the Tamil Nadu government reinforces its dedication to fostering a thriving arts community. 

The Kalaichemmal Awards are an essential part of this broader cultural vision. 

Artists are encouraged to continue their contributions to the arts and apply for recognition through this scheme. 

The initiative reflects a growing acknowledgment of the role of arts in enhancing social cohesion and cultural identity. 

In conclusion, the Scheme of Conferring ‘Kalaichemmal’ Awards is a vital program. 

It supports and uplifts artists in Tamil Nadu. 

The scheme is a clear indication of the state's commitment to preserving and promoting its rich cultural heritage. 

Through financial assistance and recognition, the awards aim to empower artists. 

This empowerment ultimately contributes to the cultural richness of Tamil Nadu.
